configuration: Nine-lane transfer and dip unit with 18 carriers
description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the 2008 Tetra Pak Hoyer Dino N2 installed between a Straightline SL 1100-F2 tunnel and a Flowrap MW 1700-9.
dimensionBasis: Tetra Pak drawing B59404537876 gives 3326 mm from the Straightline tunnel outlet to the Dino transfer centreline and a 6520 mm tunnel width. The exact installed N2 spans that cross-line width. The 2450 mm maximum height is image-scaled from the same elevation against the explicit 3630 mm tunnel height. These dimensions are installation-envelope estimates, not manufacturer-published N2 overall dimensions.
